key.name: accounts
key.summary: Mail accounts added in VATAN Posta
key.description: Display name, address, and the IMAP and SMTP server, port, security and user name of each account added by hand. Passwords are never stored here; they live in the keyring under the libsecret schema org.vatan.Posta.Password.

key.name: trusted-certificates
key.summary: Server certificates the user chose to trust
key.description: "host:port SHA-256-fingerprint" entries for servers whose certificate could not be verified and that the user accepted after seeing the fingerprint.

key.name: refresh-minutes
key.summary: Minutes between checks for new mail
key.description: Each check refreshes the inbox of every account and the open folder.
